verdict.rationale: A live llms.txt exists at dropbox.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it. However, its visible content is marketing-oriented (cloud storage, Dash, file migration) rather than developer or API guidance. Probes for markdown versions of the API docs and for any OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: developer/API-focused llms.txt content, agent-readable markdown docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration that agents can use the file effectively.
